title.zh: v1.16.16 曲风音色真正落地：159 种曲风的 LEAD/FX/低音/和弦按各自乐器发声，并修复底鼓首击无声与导出包版本戳
title.en: v1.16.16 Real per-genre timbres: all 159 genres now voice lead/FX/bass/chords with their declared instruments, plus kick first-trigger silence and stale export version-stamp fixes

highlights.zh: 曲风音色映射（核心）：曲风数据一直为 8 条轨道声明了 instrument（如 flute_lead、rhodes_ep、808_bass、sub_bass），但引擎从前忽略它，无论什么曲风都按轨道角色套同一个固定预设——长笛主导的曲风会响成锯齿合成主音。现在新增音色解析模块，按「精确预设名 → 别名表 → 轨道角色默认 → 全局默认」四级回退链取用，并把每件乐器补齐为独立合成器预设，实时播放与离线 WAV 导出解析同一个预设，导出不再与试听两套音色
highlights.en: Per-genre timbres (core): the genre data has always declared an instrument per track (flute_lead, rhodes_ep, 808_bass, sub_bass, …) but the engine ignored it and played the same fixed per-role preset for every genre — a flute-led genre sounded like a saw lead. A new resolver maps instrument → synth preset through a four-step fallback chain (exact preset key → alias table → track-role default → global default), every declared instrument now has its own synthesizer preset, and the offline WAV renderer resolves the same preset so exports match what you auditioned

highlights.zh: 数据零改动、可验证：音色映射由测试直接扫描 src/data/genres 下 159×8 个 (轨道, 乐器) 组合生成，与类型化导出交叉比对，断言没有任何一个组合落到全局默认值，且各乐器音色彼此可区分——映射表不会随数据漂移而静默失效
highlights.en: Zero data edits, fully verifiable: the mapping is enumerated by tests that scan all 159×8 (track, instrument) pairs straight out of src/data/genres, cross-check them against the typed exports, and assert that no pair falls through to the global default and that timbres are audibly distinct — so the table can never silently go stale as data drifts

highlights.zh: 修复真实缺陷：底鼓设计页的「INITIATE PULSE」首次点击无声。根因是音频上下文只由同页另一个按钮创建，先点播放就等于在静音上下文里调度。改为引擎层按需惰性创建上下文，触发时自愈并重挂分析器
highlights.en: Fixed a real defect: the kick designer's INITIATE PULSE was silent on its first click. The audio context was only ever created by the page's other button, so pressing play first scheduled into a silent context. The engine now lazily creates its context on demand and self-heals on trigger, re-attaching the analyser

highlights.zh: 修复真实缺陷：导出的 .groove 工程包版本戳一直是写死的「1.15.2」，落后两个小版本。同时补上红线 R1b——src 下只允许 src/version.ts 出现版本号字面量；红线总数 19 → 20
highlights.en: Fixed a real defect: exported .groove project packages always carried a hardcoded "1.15.2" version stamp, two minor versions stale. Added red line R1b: no version literal may appear under src/ except in src/version.ts. Red lines 19 → 20

highlights.zh: 全景声谱仪：内置声学参考测试信号发生器搬到分析仪仪器本体上——仪器头部新增电源按钮，启用后旁边的下拉框直接选择 6 种内置信号，下方原有的参考信号区块完整保留，两处共用同一个发生器实例
highlights.en: Master analyzer: the built-in acoustic reference signal generator moved onto the instrument itself — a power button in the instrument header with an adjacent dropdown for the six built-in signals, while the original reference-signal section below is kept fully intact; both share one generator instance

highlights.zh: 新增工作台（Studio）操作/交互/UI 与跨模块联动的重构规划文档：以四档视口实测数据为依据（1440×900 工具栏 173px、手机 395px 占视口 47%、常显控件 33 个、首屏只剩 2–5 条轨），给出 5 个冲刺 29 项任务与 v1.17.1–v1.17.13 里程碑，主张推广已有的渐进披露范式而非重写
highlights.en: Added a Studio refactor plan covering operations, interaction, UI and cross-module linkage, grounded in measurements across four viewports (173px toolbar at 1440×900, 395px = 47% of a phone viewport, 33 always-visible controls, only 2–5 of 8 tracks left on the first screen): 5 sprints, 29 tasks, milestones v1.17.1–v1.17.13, extending the existing progressive-disclosure pattern instead of rewriting
